_doc: Shared transform spec applied identically by the Go sink (CDC path) and the Python bulk loader (initial-load path). Processing order per row: (1) filter on ORIGINAL fields -> keep/drop; (2) computed fields (arithmetic over original numeric fields); (3) column selection (whitelist) + always keep computed; (4) rename. The key is always <table>:<source-pk>, unaffected by selection/rename. Computed numbers format as %.6f with trailing zeros/dot stripped.
